grant for a package that genuinely needs nothing. The ladder then ran against that empty grant, the

Both decoders already DETECTED it and printed 'Treat it as UNKNOWN'. That text was addressed to a

MEASURED over the committed corpus, cross-tabulating each decoder's own warning against the verdict
recorded beside it: darwin 65 failures -> 65 UNKNOWN; linux 134 -> 100 MINIMUM + 31
BROKEN-WITHOUT-JAIL-TOO + 2 + 1; win32 28 -> 26 MINIMUM + 2 ARTIFACT-GATE-SUSPECT. The non-MINIMUM
verdicts are unaffected because they do not rest on the grant being a real measurement.

pending and cost nothing extra. Re-measuring a correct record is harmless; leaving a false MINIMUM is
not.

Epoch 45 corrects epoch 44: zero attribution has TWO causes and they need OPPOSITE verdicts.

Epoch 44 made linux and win32 refuse every unattributed run, matching what measure-macos.sh had
always done. That was half right, and the half it got wrong erases true measurements.

Zero attribution means either (a) the package RUNS NOTHING at install -- npm rebuild executes no
script, so {} is a real measurement and MINIMUM is the correct verdict -- or (b) the package runs
something the subtree filter missed, where {} is a non-measurement and MINIMUM is an under-prediction.

MEASURED: of the 134 linux attribution failures, 97 are gate-vacuous, and the registry manifests of
the spot-checked ones declare only build/test/lint -- scripts npm never runs at install. So blanket
refusal converts ~97 correct MINIMUM records into non-answers in order to fix ~37 real ones. Darwin
had been paying that cost for its whole life: its 65 UNKNOWN records are the same over-caution, which
is why UNKNOWN looked like a macOS-only verdict.

All three drivers now ask the installed manifest instead of guessing. binding.gyp counts as a
declared install-time script, because npm runs node-gyp rebuild without an explicit one and those are
the packages whose grants matter most; prepare does not, because the OBSERVE arm is npm rebuild,
which never runs it. An unreadable manifest fails CLOSED.

INVALIDATES UNKNOWN. Every UNKNOWN record is a non-answer produced by the over-cautious rule, so
re-measuring can only replace it with a real verdict. The linux MINIMUM records epoch 44 reopened are
already pending and will now be measured under the corrected rule rather than the blanket one.

Epoch 13 gives the era Python to the nub arms. Until now only the OBSERVE arm and the npm reference arm held it: the VERIFY ladder and the jail-off control fell back to the runner's ambient Python, so node-gyp inside them ran a different interpreter from the arm they are compared against. This is the epoch-4 npm-reference bug on the Python axis and it points the other way -- there a spurious failure exonerated nub, here it convicts it. On macOS sudo resets the environment, so PYTHON now rides the same env vector as PATH in asIdentity rather than relying on an exported value. SCOPE: every verdict a wrong interpreter can reach. A record that found a working grant had a working Python, so every MINIMUM stands. RESIDUAL RISK, stated rather than hidden: a package whose ambient Python worked may resolve node-gyp paths differently under the era Python, which could in principle shift a minimum grant. PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE is already set on every arm, which removes the obvious such path. Cost measured before landing: 226 of 1906 reusable records (11.9%), leaving 1680.

Epoch 44 made linux and win32 refuse every unattributed run, matching what measure-macos.sh had
always done. That was half right, and the half it got wrong erases true measurements.

something the subtree filter missed, where {} is a non-measurement and MINIMUM is an under-prediction.

had been paying that cost for its whole life: its 65 UNKNOWN records are the same over-caution, which

All three drivers now ask the installed manifest instead of guessing. binding.gyp counts as a
declared install-time script, because npm runs node-gyp rebuild without an explicit one and those are
the packages whose grants matter most; prepare does not, because the OBSERVE arm is npm rebuild,
which never runs it. An unreadable manifest fails CLOSED.

INVALIDATES UNKNOWN. Every UNKNOWN record is a non-answer produced by the over-cautious rule, so
re-measuring can only replace it with a real verdict. The linux MINIMUM records epoch 44 reopened are
already pending and will now be measured under the corrected rule rather than the blanket one.

Epoch 45 corrects epoch 44: zero attribution has TWO causes and they need OPPOSITE verdicts.

Epoch 44 made linux and win32 refuse every unattributed run, matching what measure-macos.sh had
always done. That was half right, and the half it got wrong erases true measurements.

Zero attribution means either (a) the package RUNS NOTHING at install -- npm rebuild executes no
script, so {} is a real measurement and MINIMUM is the correct verdict -- or (b) the package runs
something the subtree filter missed, where {} is a non-measurement and MINIMUM is an under-prediction.

MEASURED: of the 134 linux attribution failures, 97 are gate-vacuous, and the registry manifests of
the spot-checked ones declare only build/test/lint -- scripts npm never runs at install. So blanket
refusal converts ~97 correct MINIMUM records into non-answers in order to fix ~37 real ones. Darwin
had been paying that cost for its whole life: its 65 UNKNOWN records are the same over-caution, which
is why UNKNOWN looked like a macOS-only verdict.

All three drivers now ask the installed manifest instead of guessing. binding.gyp counts as a
declared install-time script, because npm runs node-gyp rebuild without an explicit one and those are
the packages whose grants matter most; prepare does not, because the OBSERVE arm is npm rebuild,
which never runs it. An unreadable manifest fails CLOSED.

INVALIDATES UNKNOWN. Every UNKNOWN record is a non-answer produced by the over-cautious rule, so
re-measuring can only replace it with a real verdict. The linux MINIMUM records epoch 44 reopened are
already pending and will now be measured under the corrected rule rather than the blanket one.
